Team —

Thanks for carving out time this morning. I pulled together a short synthesis of the cross-team hilites and the small set of exceptions that need leadership sign-off before we lock bands for the cycle. See attached: banding_exceptions.csv (row-level notes) and synthesis_notes_v1.docx (one-page summary).

High level:
- Majority of calibration converged; variance concentrated in 7 individual cases across Eng, Product, and Platform.
- 3 cases are straightforward doc edits; 4 are sensitive (role moves / comp adjacency) and need a People Ops intake + an agreed narrative for manager + employee.

Immediate asks:
1) Please review the attached csv and flag any factual errors by 11:30am PT.
2) For the four sensitive cases, add a short proposed narrative (2–3 lines) inline in the CSV under "manager_note".
3) We should decide whether any of the four require an executive exception (SLA for comp/role moves) — I want a thumbs-up/thumbs-down reply and any objections.

I will convene a 30-min sync at 1:00pm PT to finalize language and route to People Ops. If you cannot make it, post comments to the Drive link.

Thanks —
